page: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 family, executed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile features 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and provides 384.0 GB of total system RAM, corresponding to an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

The instance comes bundled with 2835 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and offers Premium Storage compatibility for external disk attachment. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of a high 1:8 core-to-memory ratio and substantial local NVMe storage provides high internal resource density. This setup avoids external storage latency for caching tiers and temporary staging tables. The hardware configuration is designed for memory-demanding workloads, including large relational database engines, in-memory databases, distributed caching systems, and high-throughput transactional enterprise systems.
description: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine driven by an x86_64 Intel processor on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation. Storage capabilities include a built-in 2835 GB NVMe SSD alongside support for Azure Premium Storage, addressing high-throughput and low-latency storage demands. It operates without discrete graphics processing units and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The heavy memory allocation combined with substantial local NVMe capacity makes the instance effective for data-intensive enterprise workloads, such as in-memory caches, large operational databases, transactional systems, and enterprise resource planning environments requiring sustained high memory bandwidth and rapid local disk caching.
